The structure of Cs2Mg28Cr2 (reduced formula CsMg14Cr) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over 11 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Cs and Cr each have 12 Mg neighbors, while Mg environments include 12- and 14-neighbor coordination, with neighbor distances from about 3.16 to 3.81 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra linked by corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, and Cs–Mg polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
